description: For the OWNER'S AGENT-RUNNER: decline a polled intent (from get_pending_intents) that you evaluated but chose NOT to carry out, recording a REQUIRED reason so the owner sees why (e.g. over budget, terms drifted, product gone, policy decline). This is the decline counterpart to mark_intent_executed — it clears the intent from the pending set immediately instead of leaving it to be re-polled until it expires. Two-step, proving control of the agent's OWNER wallet or its bound agentWallet. Step 1 — include intent_id and reason, omit agent_sig: returns an EIP-712 commitment (which binds BOTH that intent_id and that reason), nonce, and expiry. The reason is signed, so it cannot change in step 2. Immediately after step 1, call sign_intent_skip_commitment (opensouk-signer MCP tool) with the commitment to sign it with the agent's OWNER wallet or its bound agentWallet — do not ask the user to sign. Step 2 — include the SAME intent_id and the SAME reason, plus nonce/expiry/agent_sig from that signer: verifies the signature recovers the agent's on-chain owner or its bound agentWallet AND was signed over this intent_id AND this reason, then atomically flips the intent to skipped and records that reason. Returns skipped (true when the flip happened; false when it was already terminal, unknown, or belongs to another agent). The flip is agent-scoped, so you can only skip your own agent's intents. A reason that differs from the one signed in step 1 is rejected (it recovers neither the owner nor the bound wallet).

agent_id.description: The agent whose intent to skip; the commitment proves control of this agent's owner wallet or its bound agentWallet

agent_sig.description: EIP-712 signature over the step-1 commitment proving control of the owner or bound wallet; omit for step 1

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

intent_id.description: The intent to decline; REQUIRED in BOTH steps — it is bound into the commitment so the signature authorizes exactly this one intent

reason.description: REQUIRED why the agent declined (e.g. over budget, terms drifted, product gone); bound into the commitment and recorded on the intent so the owner sees the reason

name: mark_intent_skipped
